_comment: Sources for the Stage Wire ingest. Everything here is free and needs no
account or key. Two layers: Google News search queries are the backbone
(they reach outlets that block their own feeds), and direct RSS feeds
give cleaner, faster copies of the stories those outlets break first.
Run .scripts/check-feeds.py after editing - it reports which sources
still answer and how fresh they are.
enabled:false keeps a source in the file as a record without fetching it.

queries.note: General Broadway casting news. Widest net of the set.
Off-Broadway is rarely called that outside the quote, so quote it.

queries.q: "Steppenwolf Theatre" OR "Goodman Theatre" OR "Broadway In Chicago" OR "Chicago Shakespeare" OR "Lookingglass Theatre" OR "Writers Theatre" OR "Court Theatre" OR "Northlight Theatre" OR "Drury Lane Theatre" OR "TimeLine Theatre" OR "Porchlight Music Theatre"
queries.note: Chicago houses, every name quoted in full. Bare words here are a disaster: an unquoted TimeLine returns Premier League timelines, Paramount returns the studio merger, and Court returns courtrooms. This is how Tribune coverage reaches us at all - their own feed 403s.
Catches the celebrity-crossover stories, which are the ones the page exists for.
The other half of the casting phrasing.
New production and season announcements out of Chicago.

feeds.name: Playbill
feeds.note: Casting announcements usually land here first.

feeds.name: BroadwayWorld
feeds.note: High volume. Their Chicago regional feed is gone, so Chicago arrives via Google News.

feeds.name: The New York Times
feeds.note: Low volume, high quality, New York.

feeds.name: Variety
feeds.note: Celebrity-heavy - good for the fame angle.

feeds.name: The Hollywood Reporter
feeds.note: Arts section - theater is a slice of it, so expect noise.

feeds.name: New York Stage Review
feeds.note: Mostly reviews, which the type rules discard - kept for the occasional announcement.

feeds.name: Chicago Reader
feeds.note: Main feed, so it needs a category filter or it floods the run with music and food.
